description: The pie chart represents the distribution of articles across three different years: 2017, 2018, and 2019. There are a total of three slices in the chart. The largest slice, representing the year 2019, is colored blue and accounts for 46% of the articles, with 46 articles. The second largest slice, representing the year 2018, is colored orange and accounts for 33% of the articles, with 33 articles. The smallest slice, representing the year 2017, is colored green and accounts for 21% of the articles, with 21 articles. The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, and the slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
